properties.title: NRC Report: Sodium Hydroxide near Keyser'S Ridge, MD
properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 933711 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: MD STATE HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 933711
Incident Time: 2010-02-24 19:40:00
Nearest City: Keyser'S Ridge, MD
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SODIUM HYDROXIDE
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: MD STATE HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 1050 gallons
AN ACID LEACHATE SYSTEM IN GARRETT COUNTY MD. THE LEACHATE SYSTEM WAS INACCESSIBLE FOR WEEKLY EFFLUENT MONITORING THROUGHOUT MOST OF THE MONTH OF FEBRUARY DUE TO EXTREME AMOUNTS OF SNOWFALL. ON 2/24/10, THE CONTRACTOR MAINTAINING THE SYSTEM WAS FINALLY ABLE TO ACCESS THE AREA. UPON REACHING THE TREATMENT SYSTEM, IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT ONE OF THE CHEMICAL DELIVERY LINES ADMINISTERING THE ACTIVE CHEMICAL, A 25% ENHANCED CASUSTIC SODIUM HYDROXIDE PRECIPITANT, HAD RUPTURED UNDER THE 60+ INCH SNOWPACK AT A COUPLING JOINT NEAR THE DELIVERY VALVE. THE RUPTURE HAS RESULTED IN A MAJORITY OF THE ACTIVE CHEMICAL RETAINED ON-SITE WITHIN A STORAGE TANK BEING DISCHARGED INTO THE LEACHATE TREATMENT SYSTEM'S FINAL TREATMENT CELL. THE EXACT DATE OF THE RUPTURE IS UNKNOWN DUE TO THE INABILITY OF ACCESS TO THE TREATMENT SYSTEM. APPROXIMATELY 1050 GALLONS OF THE CHEMICAL THROUGH THE RUPTURE IN THE DELIVERY LINE. THROUGHOUT THE PERIOD BETWEEN FEBRUARY 6TH AND FEBRUARY 23RD. ACCESS TO THE CLOSURE VALVE WAS GAINED ON FEBRUARY 24TH. THE MARYLAND DEPARTMENT OF THE ENVIRONMENT WAS NOTIFIED THAT SAME DAY.

properties.content:

Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: MICROSOFT OPERATIONS PUERTO RICO, LLC
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 25 gallons
INCIDENT DESCRIPTION TAKEN FROM A WEB REPORT////////ON DECEMBER 27 AT ABOUT 1430 THE SECURITY GUARD PERFORMING A ROUTINE INSPECTION INSIDE THE BUILDING DISCOVERED A DIESEL SPILL IN THE DAY TAN -1. THE SECURITY GUARD REPORT TO THE UTILITIES PERSONNEL AND THEY ARRIVED QUICKLY TO THE AREA CONFIRMING THAT THE TANK WAS OVER FILLED. THE UTILITIES PERSONNEL SHUT DOWN THE VALVES BY OPENING BREAKERS 5 & 12 IN PANEL RP11 AND PROCEED TO CLEAN THE EXCESS OF FUEL. AT THIS MOMENT THE DIESEL WAS INSIDE THE BUILDING OVER A CONCRETE PAD WHERE THE DAY TANK IS LOCATED. NO DIESEL WAS FOUND OUTSIDE THE FACILITY AFTER A PERSONNEL INSPECTION. THE UTILITIES PERSONNEL PROCEED TO RUN THE EMERGENCY GENERATOR WITH OUT LOAD AND THE DAY TANK SOLENOIDS BREAKER OPENED TO BURN THE EXCESS FUEL IN THE TANK. AFTER 15 MINUTES OF RUNNING THE EMERGENCY GENERATOR, A PERSONNEL PERFORMED AN INSPECTION OUTSIDE THE BUILDING AND HE NOTICED A SPILLED MATERIAL OVER THE GROUND. THE DAY TANK WAS OVERFLOWING THE SYSTEM THOSE NOT HAVE AN OVERFLOW RETURN PUMP SO THE FUEL WAS PUMPED OUT THROW THE EXHAUST OR THE FUEL BREADING PIPE. THE FACILITIES AND UTILITIES PERSONNEL WAS QUICKLY ACTIVATED AND ARRIVE THE AREA TO CONTROL THE EMERGENCY. THE EMERGENCY GENERATOR WAS SHUT DOWN
